global_acceptance.scenario_integration: Exercise the full feature text and its specified player/NPC consequences together; test an invalid/alternate path, not just a button or isolated data method.
global_acceptance.persistence: Save/reload before, during and after the scenario, including time skips. Repeat callback/load sequences 100 times without duplicate payments, items, evidence or sentences; test interruption recovery and supported version migration.
global_acceptance.offline_and_accessibility: Required gameplay works without network; optional AI cannot block progression. Essential controls/text/clues/timing remain usable with remapping, enlarged text and reduced motion.
global_acceptance.runtime_and_art: Record game-project compile/import and actual Unity/packaged execution, normal standing/seated/downward views, reachable geometry, collision, hands and transitions. Fix defects before accepting room/art behavior.
global_acceptance.target_performance: Profile a packaged 1920x1080 build on the actual target PC with confirmed CPU/RAM/storage/drivers: ten-minute representative route, three warm passes and separate first-load measurement. Proposed targets: mean <=16.7 ms, 1% low >=45 FPS, no recurring traversal stall >100 ms. Two-hour session must not show unbounded growth. These are unmeasured targets.
